title: Design: A/R Detail at 1536 px looks as described in both themes
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a credit memo.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-06 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1536 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the title row and the filter row.
  2. Read the column headings.
  3. Look for a sideways scroll bar under the table.
  4. Look at the "Open balance" column and the Totals row.
  5. Look across the page for overlap or clipping.
  6. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  7. Look across the page again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: title, info icon and ⋯ on one line; the filter row below.
  • Step 2: every heading on one line.
  • Step 3: there is none.
  • Step 4: "Open balance" pinned to the right edge and bold, the Totals row in the native style.
  • Step 5: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • Step 6: the page switches to dark theme.
  • Step 7: the same layout; links readable; nothing overlaps or is clipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S8-R4: “The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports.”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design pictures 1440 px only; at 1536 px compare the same elements and check for overlap.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05): the PRD says "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-80.

Design note (DR-01): the design shows the Totals row sits on a light-grey band in some pictures (A/R Collection expanded, A/P Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices, A/R Detail I32) and on the page colour in others (Summaries, I28, the same A/R Detail screen in I30). Closed without a question: PRD S8-R4: "The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports." The cases compare with Sales By Customer's Totals row; the pictures are not the reference for this one attribute.
